cards.title: Verify Signature
cards.code:
expected = HMAC_SHA256(secret, timestamp + '.' + rawBody)
secureCompare(expected, signature)
reject old timestamps
cards.description: Verify the raw request body before parsing.

cards.title: Acknowledge Quickly
cards.code:
verify -> persist event -> return 2xx
                 -> process asynchronously
cards.description: Do not make providers wait for slow business logic.

cards.title: Idempotent Consumer
cards.code:
INSERT INTO webhook_events (provider, event_id)
VALUES (?, ?)
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
cards.description: Provider event IDs prevent duplicate side effects.

cards.title: Event State Machine
cards.code:
payment.pending -> payment.succeeded
payment.pending -> payment.failed

ignore impossible or stale transitions
cards.description: Events can arrive late or out of order.

cards.title: Retry Policy
cards.code:
retry transient failures
exponential backoff + jitter
max attempts
move poison events to DLQ
manual replay tooling

cards.title: Event Log
cards.code:
provider
event_id
type
received_at
signature_valid
processing_status
attempts
last_error
cards.description: Keep enough metadata to debug and replay safely.

cards.title: Never Trust Payload Alone
cards.code:
verify signature
fetch sensitive resource from provider when needed
validate account/tenant IDs
cards.description: A valid event still needs business authorization checks.

cards.title: Secret Rotation
cards.code:
accept current + next secret during rotation
measure old-secret traffic
remove old secret after provider update
